data.name: Jaga
data.gender_notes: Jaga is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jaga is a Sanskrit name that derives from the root jagati, meaning 'to protect, to guard'. This name is often given to girls in Hindu culture to signify their role as protectors and guardians. The name Jaga carries the meaning “Protector, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jaga usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaga total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

Bestowed with this name, girls are encouraged to embody strength, courage, and the responsibilities of guardians within their families and communities.

As they embrace this name and its meaning, they acknowledge their innate ability to offer security, strength, and support to those around them – reflecting the universal unity and nurturing nature of the divine.
